description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Daxos trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
